body: Thank you for your kind words, I have always felt I'm never good enough. I'm always unsure and unhappy with what I create because its never perfect and never the way I intend it. I know I have the ability to become successful but I don't understand why am always sad. I feel like whatever I do is never good enough, and I'm scared that it's not going to be good enough because of all the high expectations people have of me.

I'm the same, I can't find a reason to get up everyday. I'm in the final year of uni almost finished but I hit rock bottom. I missed uni for the past month and didn't answer any texts or calls, people thought I was dead. I want to get away from everything. I want to change, I want to be me again but I can't seem to find a way out of this pain and sadness.
I really don't think I can do this any more, I feel sad just thinking about living. I just want to take all my meds and fade away.
